note: Metering must stay quotable: one record per consumption event, with a purpose that decides whether it can be billed at all.

cases.why: a record without an id cannot be deduplicated on replay
resource layers are the six in the framework; an unknown layer breaks split accounting
negative cost would invert the ledger
an unknown unit makes quantity incomparable across providers
billable must be a boolean, not a truthy string
the three purpose classes drive pool allocation; a fourth must fail
trace ids are fixed-width so they can be joined without ambiguity

validMutations.why: internal maintenance work is recorded but carries no charge
internal work can consume real cost and still be non-billable; the gate must allow it

semanticCases.why: billable must be derivable from cost; a free record marked billable would double-charge
self-improvement consumption belongs to the reserved pool and must never be billed to a customer
semanticCases.expect: internal purpose must not be billable
